summary: Backend + frontend smoke testing for the new 'Reversal Pre-FVG' (counter_trend) strategy. Rewrote /app/backend/tests/test_counter_trend.py into a pytest suite (14 tests, ALL PASSING) covering analyze_pair_counter LONG + SHORT mirror entry logic, R:R gate, direction invariant (no-breakout returns None), full manage_counter_position state machine (before TP1, at TP1 -> 65% partial with ATR SL kept, +0.5% advance -> SL moved to TP1+maker+taker fees & breakeven_active=True, <0.5% -> SL stays, TP2 -> close_paper_position win), and regression HTTP endpoints (PUT /api/config with strategy_mode=counter_trend persists, POST /api/scan returns 200, GET /api/signals returns {signals,count}, scoring & impulse_fvg modes still scan). Frontend smoke on /settings: tapping testID 'strategy-counter_trend' (label 'Rev Pre-FVG') reveals the 'Reversal Pre-FVG Strategy' section with all 5 inputs (input-ct-consol-min / -consol-atr / -tp1-pct / -tp2-pct / -post-tp1); Save Configuration persists strategy_mode=counter_trend to backend (verified via GET /api/config).
critical_code_review_comments: analyze_pair_counter (server.py:1722-1856) matches the spec exactly: box_high/low entry, ATR-buffered SL beyond the box, target FVG = bearish above for LONG / bullish below for SHORT, TP2 = FVG far edge, TP1 = midpoint, breakout via last CLOSED candle close beyond box edge, volume+RSI HTF+momentum+divergence gates all enforced.
manage_counter_position (server.py:1213-1257) correctly keeps original ATR SL after TP1 partial and only moves SL to tp1+fee(maker+taker) once price advances >= post_tp1_advance_pct beyond TP1.
seed_data_creation: None. Only Config.strategy_mode is toggled through the public /api/config endpoint during regression tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full pytest suite for the Reversal Pre-FVG strategy lives in /app/backend/tests/test_counter_trend.py. To run it standalone: `EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=... python -m pytest backend/tests/test_counter_trend.py -v`. The suite monkeypatches server.kucoin.get_klines and server.rsi_wilder / _rsi_momentum_turn / detect_rsi_divergence to isolate structural logic. Unrelated test file /app/backend/tests/test_impulse_strategy.py errors at collection when EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL isn't exported (not touched by this iteration).
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. Only ambiguity encountered was inner_text() on Expo web returning uppercase-transformed text; resolved by matching case-insensitively in the Playwright smoke.
